A.claim: Exact reduction of the sparsest mod-72 class (x,y even, z odd): a counterexample there is exactly a coprime opposite-parity pair (u,v) with Re((u+vi)^z) and Im((u+vi)^z) both perfect powers (exponents >= 2), and C = u^2+v^2. Derivation: C is odd (kernel-verified not_both_exponents_even_of_even_C), so a+bi, a-bi are coprime in the UFD Z[i]; units ar

B.claim: No Beal counterexample of signature (2m,2n,3) with m>=4 and n>=4. Even m or even n: signature (4,2n,3) / (2m,4,3), excluded by BCDY 2015 Thm 1. Both odd (>=5): C odd forces a+bi=(u+vi)^3 in Z[i]; on whichever side 3 does not divide the parameter, (s^2)^m+(-eps t)^m=3v^2 with m odd, forbidden by Bennett-Skinner 2004 Thm 1.1 (C=3).
